meta.name: pyqt-logging-console-panel
meta.description: Provide in-app log viewer and debug report export for PyQt desktop apps. Use when troubleshooting needs to happen inside the app.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 PyQt 桌面应用内查看日志并导出调试报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在开发 PyQt 桌面应用并需要在应用内排查问题
copy.tagline_en: View logs and export debug reports inside PyQt desktop apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop PyQt desktop apps and need in-app troubleshooting

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为你的 PyQt 桌面应用添加一个内置的日志查看面板，可以实时显示运行日志、过滤日志、自动滚动，并支持导出包含堆栈跟踪和应用版本信息的调试报告。
howto.when: 当你在开发或调试 PyQt 桌面应用，需要在应用内部查看日志或导出调试报告时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个 PyQt 应用加一个日志控制台面板。
say.note: Claude 会生成日志面板的规格说明。

say.text: 添加日志过滤和自动滚动功能。
say.note: Claude 会实现过滤和尾部行为。

say.text: 生成可复制的错误报告，包含堆栈和应用版本。
say.note: Claude 会输出错误报告导出功能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will add a built-in log viewer panel to your PyQt desktop app, displaying runtime logs in real-time with filtering, auto-scroll, and exportable debug reports including stack trace and app version info.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to view logs or export debug reports inside a PyQt desktop app during development or debugging.

say_en.text: Add a logging console panel to this PyQt app.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the panel spec.

say_en.text: Add log filtering and auto-scroll behavior.
say_en.note: Claude will implement filtering and tail behavior.

say_en.text: Generate a copyable error report with stack trace and app version.
say_en.note: Claude will output the error report export feature.
